comparison.objective: Lengthen a walking stick to a mark and bayonet-lock it; candidate sets and jam-nut-locks a gripper opening.
comparison.physical_skill: Twist out of a notch, translate a tube, and twist into another notch versus simultaneous driver/wrench countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Marked extension engaged in the bayonet notch and released versus angular setting retained through three functional cycles.
comparison.reason: This is a close set-and-lock objective, but its axial bayonet manipulation lacks coupled screw/nut reaction and cycle-retention testing.
